Before we

Can I share a reference blouse design?+

Yes. Send your reference images on WhatsApp so the boutique can discuss how the pattern could work with your fabric and preferences.

How do I enquire about a pattern blouse?+

Share your name, fabric or saree details, the design you have in mind and your required date. The boutique will discuss the next steps with you directly.
